events.title: Newmark Group (NMRK) Tops Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: Newmark Group (NMRK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +22.22% and +13.89%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: First Busey (BUSE) Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: First Busey (BUSE) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +17.13% and -0.47%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Unpacking Q4 Earnings: WillScot Mobile Mini (NASDAQ:WSC) In The Context Of Other Construction and Maintenance Services S
events.body: Looking back on construction and maintenance services stocks’ Q4 earnings, we examine this quarter’s best and worst performers, including WillScot Mobile Mini (NASDAQ:WSC) and its peers.
